gloss: teacup saucer; coaster for a teacup

definitions.gloss: teacup saucer; coaster for a teacup
definitions.explanation: A small saucer or coaster placed under a Japanese teacup to catch drips and protect the surface beneath. Typically made of wood, lacquer, or bamboo.

examples.japanese: お{茶|ちゃ}を{茶托|ちゃたく}に{載|の}せて{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I served the tea on a saucer.

examples.japanese: {漆塗|うるしぬ}りの{茶托|ちゃたく}を{使|つか}った。
examples.english: I used a lacquered tea saucer.

examples.japanese: お{客|きゃく}さまにお{茶|ちゃ}を{出|だ}すときは、{必|かなら}ず{茶托|ちゃたく}を{使|つか}うのがマナーだ。
examples.english: It is proper etiquette to always use a tea saucer when serving tea to guests.

notes:
USAGE:
A traditional item of Japanese tea service. When serving tea to guests in homes or offices, it is considered proper etiquette to place the teacup on a {茶托|ちゃたく}. Materials range from simple wood to fine lacquerware.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶托|ちゃたく}に{載|の}せる (to place on a tea saucer)
- {木製|もくせい}の{茶托|ちゃたく} (wooden tea saucer)
- {漆|うるし}の{茶托|ちゃたく} (lacquered tea saucer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ソーサー: saucer (Western-style, for coffee cups)
- コースター: coaster (for cold drinks)
